$comment: Mixer, master dynamics and propagation. Buses: engines, aero, reentry, events, cabin, ui -> master; gainDb applies to an outside listener (kinds external and map), interiorGainDb to the cabin mix, ramped over smoothing.listenerKind on a view change. Gain staging: in the loudest realistic scenes (booster cluster at 25 m, every loud event at once) every bus peaks below 0 dBFS, and the master is fed to its soft ceiling below linearUntil (tests/browser/audio/audio-offline.spec.ts). Master: compressor, then makeupDb (the DynamicsCompressorNode's own automatic makeup gain is cancelled exactly, mapping.compressorMakeupDb, so the small-signal gain of the master is gainDb + compressor.makeupDb), a limiter (its automatic makeup also cancelled), then a soft ceiling: exactly linear below linearUntil, a tanh knee above, never beyond ceiling. fadeAboveWarp buses fade to exact silence over warp.fadeTime when warpFactor > warp.threshold. propagation: airborne gain (p / referencePressure)^pressureGainExponent (0 in vacuum), low-pass cutoff from pressure and from distance (air absorption), inverse-distance attenuation beyond the source's refDistance, faded out between airborneFadeStart and airborneFadeEnd; the delay is the exact retarded time of a source moving with its vessel's air-relative velocity (supersonic sources reach only listeners inside their Mach cone, faded over coneEdge) on a maxDelay-second delay line. hull: what of the airborne path reaches a cabin listener. structure: attenuation along the vessel for structure-borne sound. attach: the faint structure-borne share an outside listener hears from the vessel its camera is attached to (AudioListener.attachedVesselId; full within fullDistance of that vessel's bounding sphere about its VES origin, none beyond maxDistance; a free or ground-fixed camera hears none). mapListener: where a map listener stands (VES) before any outside flight camera was seen; afterwards it stands where the last one was.
